name: Kansas

agency.name: Kansas Department of Health and Environment (KDHE)

overview: Kansas requires a state construction permit (K.A.R. 28-19-300(a)) or, below permit thresholds, a construction approval (28-19-300(b)) before beginning actual construction or modification. Operating permits are Class I (Kansas's Title V permit) or Class II (federally enforceable limits, including permits-by-rule). PSD is implemented under K.A.R. 28-19-350, adopting portions of 40 CFR 52.21. All applications go through KEIMS.

permitTypes.name: Construction Approval
permitTypes.description: Required when a construction permit is not, for new sources or modifications above approval thresholds, most minor NSPS and NESHAP sources, and sources accepting operational restrictions under K.A.R. 28-19-302(c). Fee $750 per application (K.A.R. 28-19-304(a)).
permitTypes.thresholds: Per KDHE overview (2016): PM 5 lb/hr; agricultural PM10 5 lb/hr; other PM10 2 lb/hr; SO2/SO3 2 lb/hr; CO 50 lb/24-hr; VOC 50 lb/24-hr (15 lb/24-hr or 3 lb/hr in Wyandotte or Johnson counties); NOx 50 lb/24-hr; lead 0.1 lb/hr.

permitTypes.name: State Construction Permit
permitTypes.description: Required for new sources and modifications where potential-to-emit reaches the permit threshold, plus Title IV affected sources, most incinerators, and new major HAP sources. Land clearing and equipment purchase may occur before the permit; foundation work may not.
permitTypes.thresholds: Per KDHE overview (PTE, tons/yr): PM 25; PM10 15; agricultural PM/PM10 100; SO2/SO3 40; CO 100; VOC 40; NOx 40; lead 0.6; single HAP 10; combined HAPs 25.

permitTypes.name: Class II Permits-by-Rule
permitTypes.description: Available for reciprocating engines, organic solvent evaporative sources, hot mix asphalt facilities, and sources with actual emissions below 50% of major source thresholds. $50 fee.

permitTypes.name: Class II Operating Permit (FESOP)
permitTypes.description: Lowers potential to emit through federally enforceable limits. Fees: initial $200, modification $100, general application $50.

permitTypes.name: Prevention of Significant Deterioration
permitTypes.thresholds: Per KDHE overview: major source 100 tons/yr PTE for listed categories, 250 tons/yr otherwise. Significance levels include CO 100, NOx 40, SO2 40, PM 25, PM10 15, PM2.5 10, VOC 40, lead 0.6, GHG 75,000 tons CO2e.

permitTypes.name: Class I Operating Permit (Title V)
permitTypes.description: Consolidates all air requirements; satisfies Title V. Also required for Title IV sources, CAA §129(e) incinerators, non-exempt NSPS/NESHAP sources, and NSPS WWW landfills. Fees: initial $3,000, renewal $3,000, significant modification $1,500.
permitTypes.thresholds: Per KDHE overview: individual HAP 10 tons/yr or more; combined HAPs 25 tons/yr or more; any other regulated pollutant 100 tons/yr or more.

oilAndGas.summary: KDHE notes gas well drilling and completion are subject to NSPS OOOO (40 CFR 60.5375(a)), and initial drilling requires a Gas Well Notification Form. Other oil and gas activities may need a construction permit or approval; compressor engines can use the reciprocating engine Class II permit-by-rule.

programs.name: Gas Well Notification
programs.description: Notification for initial gas well drilling subject to NSPS OOOO.

regulations.title: Operating permits (Class I and Class II)

guidance.name: Overview of Kansas Air Quality Program (Rev. 8, 2016)

notes: Thresholds come from KDHE's 2016 program overview, which says to consult the official regulations before final decisions. Local air agencies in Kansas were not reviewed.
